### God of the Hills and Valleys
Author: Dr. Avril Occilien-Similien
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-7-2026.html
Passage: 1 Kings 20:28
Points:
- Life frequently alternates between joyful highs and sudden, painful valleys.
- Israel's enemies mistakenly presumed God's power was restricted only to the hills.
- God proved that His presence and authority are not confined by geography or circumstances.
- Believers often find it harder to recognize God during trials than during seasons of blessing.
- God invites us to seek Him and experience His constant peace even in deep hardship.

### How to Rest Knowing We Serve a God of the Hills and Valleys
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/how-to-rest-knowing-we-serve-a-god-of-the-hills-and-valleys.html
Passage: 1 Kings 20:28
Points:
- The Arameans wrongly thought the God of Israel was limited to mountainous terrain.
- God displayed His absolute sovereignty by delivering victory in the valley as well.
- Hills represent seasons of blessing and praise, whereas valleys represent seasons of trouble and sorrow.
- Because God's nature never changes, His presence remains constant across every situation.
- Recognizing God's ongoing work allows believers to rest with peace in any circumstance.
